items.rationale: The shop measured 41,200 mWh against a design capacity of 52,000 mWh (79.2%), below the 80% cutoff in §2.6.8, and no waiver applies. Sections 2.6.7 and 5.2.3 exclude the diagnostic even though it established ineligibility; if covered, an ordinary €65 gross fee would be below the €250 cap.

items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: The swerve and impact otherwise qualify under §§2.6.2–2.6.3, but the below-80% battery finding and absence of a waiver make the entire unit ineligible under §2.6.8. If covered, the pictured €549 parts-and-labour quote is the estimate for the combined repair under §7.1.10.
